newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers up, southern France very tight.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers up, southern France very tight.

text.p: European bunker prices all gained on Monday, particularly in southern France where supply tightness was particularly acute, dealers said.
Fos fuel oil bunkers were up around $10 to $120 ex wharf offered for 380 CST. One major was reportedly short, while another had almost no product available.
"There really are some quite big problems of avails there," one French dealer said.
Rotterdam 380 CST continued to climb, up about $2 to $113/$114 fob. Dealers said the rise was the result of barge market gains which were divorced from bunker demand.

On a thin Monday, enquiries were below 10,000 tonnes. Diesel and gas oil prices varied considerably as some dealers attempted to provide loss-leading offers in combination with larger fuel oil deliveries.
Mediterranean prices were a shade firmer in most parts, including Spain and Italy, with little sign of demand.
Durban bunker prices were stable, but still strong. Continued repairs at a refinery there left the market devoid of fuel oil supply.
Fujairah also showed no sign of dipping with support from a firm Gulf fuel market. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 5000
